title: Foundation Models for Event Prediction Across Heterogeneous Event Logs
abstract: arXiv:2610.17503v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Event logs are ubiquitous across real-world domains, including business processes, manufacturing workflows, healthcare, and many other operational systems. Yet event logs can differ substantially in their event semantics, label spaces, interaction patterns, and temporal scales, making it difficult to build a single foundation model that generalizes directly to previously unseen systems. We address this challenge with the Foundation Event Predictor (FEP), a simple and scalable in-context architecture that performs next-event prediction through learned, event-level nonparametric inference. Causal self-attention encodes context and target histories into key and query representations, respectively, while the observed next context events are encoded as values. translated_title: 跨异构事件日志的事件预测基础模型
translated_abstract: 事件日志在现实世界的各个领域中无处不在，包括业务流程、制造工作流、医疗保健以及许多其他运营系统。然而，事件日志在事件语义、标签空间、交互模式和时间尺度上可能存在显著差异，这使得构建一个能够直接泛化到前所未见系统的单一基础模型变得非常困难。我们通过基础事件预测器（Foundation Event Predictor, FEP）来解决这一挑战，这是一种简单且可扩展的上下文学习架构，通过学习的、事件级别的非参数推理来执行下一事件预测。因果自注意力机制将上下文历史和目标历史分别编码为键和查询表示，而观测到的下一上下文事件则被编码为值。随后，交叉注意力机制对所有上下文转换中的下一事件结果执行学习的、相关性加权的聚合，从而使整个非参数预测过程能够……
tldr: 本文提出基础事件预测器（FEP），一种简单可扩展的上下文学习架构，通过事件级别的非参数推理实现下一事件预测，并能泛化到来自未见系统的异构事件日志。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the Foundation Event Predictor (FEP), a simple and scalable in-context architecture that performs next-event prediction through learned event-level nonparametric inference, enabling generalization across heterogeneous event logs from previously unseen systems.
